<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { TimeRangeFieldRoot, type TimeRangeFieldRootEmits, type TimeRangeFieldRootProps, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<TimeRangeFieldRootProps>();
const emits = defineEmits<TimeRangeFieldRootEmits>();
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Start and end segments. Render each segment value inside an input.
   */
  default?: (props: {
    modelValue: { start?: unknown; end?: unknown } | undefined;
    segments: {
      start: { part: string; value: string }[];
      end: { part: string; value: string }[];
    };
    isInvalid: boolean;
  }) => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <TimeRangeFieldRoot
    v-slot="slotProps"
    data-slot="time-range-field"
    class="sigma-ui-time-range-field"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </TimeRangeFieldRoot>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-time-range-field {
  display: inline-flex;
  height: 2.25rem;
  align-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--input);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background-color: transparent;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  padding-inline: 0.75rem;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { TimeRangeFieldInput, type TimeRangeFieldInputProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<TimeRangeFieldInputProps>();
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props);
</script>

<template>
  <TimeRangeFieldInput
    data-slot="time-range-field-input"
    class="sigma-ui-time-range-field-input"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </TimeRangeFieldInput>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-time-range-field-input {
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  outline: none;
  padding-inline: 0.125rem;
}

.sigma-ui-time-range-field-input:focus {
  background-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent-foreground);
}
</style>

export { default as TimeRangeField } from './TimeRangeField.vue';
export { default as TimeRangeFieldInput } from './TimeRangeFieldInput.vue';
